en: The postcard depicts an old, round, brick tower located on grassy terrain. The structure is partially ruined and appears to have small, round windows and other architectural details suggestive of fortification or guidance. There is another building or wall partially visible beside the tower, and some trees in the background. The image is sepia-toned and gives a historical impression. In the top right, printed text reads: 'REVAL Der falsche Leuchtturm in Wiems.'
